scope: Proposition 4.10 of the manuscript “Global Spherical Shells on Minimal Surfaces of Class VII” (preprints/Global-Spherical-Shells-on-Minimal-Surfaces-of-Class-VII-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 060 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d441e45f773bce9f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let E be a compact datum supported in a cut-open period of a finite cyclic quotient Xn = Y/Tn, with its trivializations fixed in collars of the cut. Equip E with an integrable operator dE satisfying (4.3), and let e be its compact support Chern class. For a, b > 0 its weighted Dolbeault index is 2 ∑ q=0 (−1)q dim H0,q a,b (Y, E) = 1 + 1 2 ( e2 − KY · e ) . (4.16) The products on the right are compact support intersection pairings. In particular, if e2 = KY · e, the section space is one-dimensional, its positive-end coefficient is nonzero on every nonzero section, and H0,1 a,b (Y, E) = 0.
